_about: Recorded explanations from the CURRENT (unchanged) tutor prompt, for the offline baseline. The current prompt asks for 'plain flowing prose' but lacks the relative-difficulty constraint, so it mostly produces plain explanations yet FAILS on the hard-vocabulary / irony / dense-philosophy class (reaching for academic jargon harder than the source). The communistic case is the documented failure. Keys: 'passage_id|lens|tier|model'. A live baseline is reproduced with --models anthropic/local once a model is configured; this curated subset is enough to lock the gate and prove it flags the known failure.

explanations.iron-02|explain|deep|sonnet: The trick is that the sentence pretends to report a neutral law of nature while really voicing the local mothers' point of view. By dressing a piece of village gossip in the calm clothes of a universal truth, the line quietly mocks both the certainty and the marriage-hunting it describes, so the reader laughs before any character has even spoken.
explanations.vict-12|explain|deep|local: The passage performs a kind of pseudo-scholarly mimicry, adopting the solemn, doctrinaire cadence of nineteenth-century socialist theorizing to lend its utopian premise an air of institutional gravitas.
